estimates.assumptions: 1.5 cups dry brown lentils (approx 300g); values for dry weight, par-cooked as described
1.5 cups uncooked white rice (approx 300g); values for dry/uncooked weight before boiling with lentils
1/2 tsp ground coriander; modest quantity for seasoning
2 cups dry elbow macaroni (approx 200g); values for dry weight before boiling
one standard 400g can chickpeas, drained (edible portion ~240g); values for drained, heated chickpeas
1 large onion (~150g), used for crispy topping; values for raw onion before frying
1/2 cup vegetable oil; total quantity used for frying onions (most is absorbed or used in pan, not all consumed but counted as recipe contribution)
